source.title: Pharmacokinetics of minocycline with and without rifampicin co-administration in patients with nontuberculous mycobacterial disease

extraction_limitations: Supplementary Tables S1-S3 were referenced by the article but were not present in the supplied PDF and were not used to invent eligibility, assay, or withdrawal details.

The study reports pharmacokinetic exposure and short-course safety; it does not establish clinical efficacy, a validated PK/PD target in patients, or a clinically validated minocycline dose adjustment during rifampicin.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review; validation confirms structure/sufficiency, not independent human verification.
